description: This file provides mock functionalities for Node.js built-in modules, including functions to resolve mock overrides and default exports, as well as a function to asynchronously create mocked modules with optional default property mirroring.

methods.name: function resolveMockOverrides<TModule extends object>( resolveMockOverrides
methods.description: Resolves mock overrides by executing the factory if it is a function or returning the partial overrides directly.

methods.name: function resolveDefaultBase<TModule extends object>(actual: TModule): Record<string, unknown> { resolveDefaultBase
methods.description: Extracts the default export from the module if present, otherwise returns the module itself.

methods.name: export async function mockNodeBuiltinModule<TModule extends object>( mockNodeBuiltinModule
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an actual module, applies mock overrides, and optionally mirrors overrides to the default export.
